scope: Verification of a smeared mixed-mode cohesive patch and eccentric elastic shell lap. Not a calibrated rivet, metal tearing model, wing impact or historical reconstruction.

material.classification: Generic elastic reference, no shell yielding or failure

joint.property: TYPE43 Ismstr=4, LAW117 Imass=2 Idel=4 Irupt=2 EXP_BK=1 Gamma=1
joint.classification: Smeared cohesive proxy for one equivalent connection over 254 mm2; NOT physical adhesive or resolved rivet. Peak-force scaling inherited from I02B; stiffness, energy, spatial distribution and mode interaction are own hypotheses.

contact.classification: Independent shell contact active before and after cohesive deletion; no friction or damping credit; no edge-to-edge contact. Warning 94 is explicitly allowed only for disjoint main/secondary shell sets; it cautions about self-contact when gap exceeds half an element edge. Gap is not reduced to hide this warning.

final_revision: R5: True_thickness=0 leaves the current geometrical offset to the full-nonlinear element, avoiding the artificial fixed moment arm at finite opening. Imass=1 explicitly retains areal numerical mass. No physical strength, energy or tolerance has been retuned. R4 corrects only pure shear because its fixed 2.5 mm arm becomes wrong when the opening changes. Nonproportional independent reference must retain both maximum separation kappa and maximum damage, as documented in the primary implementation; actual U is also reconstructed directly from tractions.
cohesive_mass_definition: R4: Imass=1, numerical areal mass 1e-12 g/mm2, total 2.54e-10 g. The rho-labelled joint input is interpreted as areal mass for this flag, NOT aluminum volumetric density. Imass=2 in R1-R3 also returned area times rho in the installed binary; no physical cohesive-layer mass is inferred. No mass scaling.
accepted_revision: R3: True_thickness=2.5 mm matches the midsurface offset. Explicit 1 mm in R2 creates an incorrect moment arm despite matching force/work and is rejected. Default R1 had correct moments but ambiguous mass reference and IBAG warning. R0/R1/R2 retained. BRIC converter orders OFF, IE then six local stresses regardless of requested order. Patch constitutive forces are audited from local stresses; grip impulse differences independently verify boundary work and momentum. Central differences near contact activation mix adjacent compressive states and must not be mistaken for cohesive force.
